messages:
alina: Heads-up: partners keep opening parallel warrooms with different signals. proposing a small pilot to standardize partner SEV intake across CloudAxis (marketplace) and OrionSI (SI). want a minimal, partner-friendly pattern. thoughts?

matt: +1. too many duplicate bridges last month, confused who actually owns the page.

jordan: agree. what are we standardizing exactly? channel names, auto-warroom creation, orcomms templates?

sara: all three ideally. start small: channel naming + an email->slack bridge for HW partners who lack SSO, plus a one-page partner checklist.

kevin: we need clear ownership matrix. suggestion: partner posts to partner-sev-<name>-prod -> that auto-creates a warroom link and notifies the 'partner-sev-pilot' oncall.

alina: name conv proposal: partner-sev-<partner>-<env> (example: partner-sev-cloudaxis-prod). put primary/secondary on topic.

jordan: I'll build an automation ticket INF-5421 to create the warroom + update channel topic from the slash command. ETA Thu EOD.

matt: slash command idea: `/partner-warroom create cloudaxis --env prod` -> returns Zoom + docs + incident template. keeps partners from having to DM multiple people.

kevin: add required incident fields on initial post: impact, start_time, example_req, repro steps (if applicable). forces structured posts and reduces chattiness.

oncall-bot: Notice: rotation 'partner-sev-pilot' scheduled. Week1 primary: matt, Week2 primary: jordan.

sara: I'll draft partner-facing checklist and onboarding email. initial scope prod only. will loop in CloudAxis and OrionSI after internal dry run.

matt: hardware partners might not be in Slack due to SSO. fallback: email to bridge -> mailbox -> #partner-bridge-mailbox -> oncall relay. include that fallback in runbook.

alina: yes please. also document escalation hours and expected SLAs in the channel topic so partners know when to expect a reply.

jordan: snippet I'm adding to INF-5421 for channel topic format:
```
Primary: @matt | Secondary: @jordan | SLA: 30m ack / 4h remediation target
Warroom: https://zoom.us/xxxx | Runbook: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/partner-sev-pilot
```

kevin: test plan: Day0 internal dry run, Day1 simulated partner SEV, Day3 monitored live traffic. capture metrics: time-to-ack, time-to-first-comment, time-to-resolve, number of handoffs, duplicate-warrooms avoided.

sara: I'll schedule a 30m kickoff Fri 10am and prepare partner comms.

oncall-bot: Reminder: incident logging template will be enforced for channels tagged 'partner-sev-pilot'.

alina: action items recap: INF-5421 (jordan) auto-creation + topic updates by Thu; partner checklist (kevin) by Fri; partner comms + onboarding (sara) by Fri; pilot starts Mon for 2 weeks.

matt: sounds good. small ask: keep the warroom creation step reversible so we don't clutter Zoom accounts. auto-create + auto-expire after 7 days unless extended.

kevin: noted. I'll include extension flow in checklist and how partners can reopen incidents if needed.

sara: will DM CloudAxis contact list after draft is ready. keep scope narrow first — prevents scope creep. :eyes: :thumbsup:

alina: thanks all. we'll iterate based on pilot metrics and then publish the final partner SEV playbook.
